title: The Naming
note: Renata's interior of Mnehmos's descent + address. She holds her arm raised through the count. Hears her name spoken aloud for first time. Notes Mnehmos's stand-back instruction by name. Her arm lowers on count completion, not signal. Her first spoken line in this world is 'Noted.' Triage roster now has names.

events.observed: Mnehmos descends 7 shallow steps; brass cools as he crosses; chamber's center of gravity shifts
Severa (still unnamed by system) moves toward 2 tremor-handed summoners; not running

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Cole Maddox. Renata Salk. Bohdan Cerny. Yuki Aritomo. Wren Adebayo.
events.renata_reaction: Did not flinch at her own name. Flinched at the accuracy. 'Selection implies purpose. Purpose implies constraint.'

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: I am Mnehmos. I performed the rite that brought you here.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: You are in Sebastopyr. This chamber is in the Cathedral Sebastinum, above the Vas Halidani that holds the Grace I spent to bring you. The city beyond it is real. So are its risks.

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: The understanding that lets our speech meet is provisional. It will hold until the third day at evening.

events.returned: LANGUAGE BRIDGE: PROVISIONAL · expires PD 606 · DAY 3 · 18:00

events.speaker: 29171068 (Mnehmos)
events.spoken: Stand back from Salk until she lowers her arm — she is finishing a triage from her own world; let her arrive in her own time.
events.renata_reaction: She is holding a boundary; Mnehmos has just named it. Attendant complies, waits in peripheral.

events.returned: ATTENDED: 2 tremor-handed summoners · STATUS: STABLE PENDING REVIEW

events.note: First spoken line in this world. No gratitude. No hope. Working clinical acknowledgement.
